profile.headline: Software Engineer at Grainger
profile.summary: Growing up I always had a fascination with mathematics and computers. I took that love and began studying to become an Actuary. I realized after a bit that I wouldn't be happy doing that for the rest of my life. That's when I began to pursue a love of mine which was programming. I have loved the switch and look forward to keep growing and learning as a developer.

organizations.name: Free Code Camp Fresno
organizations.description: Helped organize bi-monthly meetups. Also assisted with mentoring new developers setting up their development environments as well as teach a variety of intro development topics.
